falsification_conditions.condition: BTC closes above $108,000 on any daily candle
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A close above the August 2024 high would break the lower-high structure that defines the bottom_2024_aug pattern, invalidating the HOLD signal and suggesting a new uptrend is underway rather than continued consolidation

falsification_conditions.condition: Funding rate on perpetual swaps exceeds 0.05% for 3 consecutive 8-hour intervals
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained positive funding at that level indicates aggressive leveraged longs entering, which contradicts the low-conviction, post-bottom accumulation phase implied by the 74% pattern match and would signal a blowoff top instead of a bottom

falsification_conditions.condition: BTC 7-day realized volatility drops below 18% annualized
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern assumes elevated volatility during the base-building phase; a collapse to sub-18% vol would indicate a completed compression and imminent expansion, meaning the HOLD window has ended and the next directional move is already underway

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
